designer_intent.focus: Create a dark, club-ready trip hop arrangement emphasizing sample chopping techniques for rhythmic and textural variety.

presetor_intent.instructions: Apply effects and mixing presets to preserve the raw energy of sample chops while ensuring clarity and punch suitable for club play.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns using chopped samples emphasizing transient and staccato hits for dark trip hop rhythm.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines from sample chops with glide and slide articulation to support club energy.

harmony_generator.brief: Arrange chord layers from chopped harmonic samples with smooth crossfades and dark tonal color.

melody_generator.brief: Add melodic elements with subtle sample chops and fading to complement arrangement mood.

ai_designer.brief: Design overall arrangement structure and energy profile adhering to dark trip hop and club energy target.

presetor.brief: Select and apply effect presets matching trip hop style with emphasis on chopped sample textures.

songgps.brief: Ensure arrangement aligns with mainstream trip hop variation and maintains energy curve suitable for club environment.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Process unprocessed channel audio to balance clarity, punch, and dark atmospheric texture.
